doc.title: Epic 9: Multi-LLM Provider Support - Gemini 3.0 Pro
doc.section: Story 9.1: Refactor LLM Client into Provider Abstraction (lines 119-143)
doc.snippet: Extract existing Grok/ChatGPT logic into provider pattern without breaking current functionality. Factory pattern for provider instantiation, zero API changes, backward compatibility guaranteed.

doc.title: Epic 9: Provider Abstraction Architecture
doc.snippet: Provider abstraction layer with BaseProvider interface. Runtime provider detection via LLM_PROVIDER env var. Shared interface ensures feature parity across providers.

doc.title: Annie Architecture Plan
doc.snippet: Backend API integrates with LLM providers (Grok-4, ChatGPT-5) via unified client. Supports streaming responses, function calling for MCP tools, and Langfuse observability.

doc.title: Story 8.2: Chat Endpoint Tracing
doc.snippet: Langfuse tracing integrated with LLM client using contextvars for async-safe trace management. Fire-and-forget pattern (batch_size=10, flush_interval=1s). Cost calculation with token tracking. Text truncation to 1000 chars.

doc.title: Story 8.1: Core Langfuse Integration
doc.snippet: Langfuse singleton client with lazy initialization. Contextvars for request-scoped tracing. Graceful degradation when Langfuse unavailable. No blocking on trace failures.

doc.title: Story 2.2: LLM Client Setup & Provider Management
doc.snippet: Unified LLM client with Grok-4 (primary) and ChatGPT-5 (fallback). Automatic provider failover, rate limiting detection, structured error logging. Environment-based configuration.

doc.title: Tech Spec Epic 2: Core Chat & LLM Integration
doc.section: LLM Client Design and Implementation Details
doc.snippet: Comprehensive LLM client specification including provider configuration, streaming support, function calling, error handling patterns, and performance requirements.

artifact.reason: Complete current implementation to be refactored into provider pattern. Contains Grok-4 and ChatGPT-5 logic, streaming, function calling, cost calculation, error handling.
Configuration and initialization logic to be moved to factory pattern. Loads API keys, timeouts, Grok Live Search settings.
Exception hierarchy to preserve in refactored code. Custom exceptions for provider errors and rate limiting.
Langfuse tracing integration using contextvars for async-safe trace management. Must be preserved in provider implementations.
Cost calculation logic for LLM usage. Must be integrated into provider calculate_cost() methods.
Singleton Langfuse client pattern. Providers must use this for trace/generation tracking.
Configuration loading utility used by all providers for environment variable access.
Structured logging utility. All providers must use for consistent logging.
Existing test suite that must pass without modification after refactoring. Tests streaming, function calling, error handling.
Langfuse tracing tests. Must verify tracing still works after refactoring to provider pattern.

constraint.title: Zero Breaking Changes
constraint.description: Existing imports must work: 'from api.llm_client import LLMClient'. Existing method signatures unchanged. All existing tests must pass without modification.

constraint.title: No Latency Regression
constraint.description: First token latency must remain <500ms. Memory usage comparable to before refactoring. Provider instantiation overhead <10ms.

constraint.title: Preserve Langfuse Integration
constraint.description: All tracing from Story 8.2 must continue working. Cost tracking must be maintained. Generation tracking with text truncation (1000 chars). Fire-and-forget pattern preserved.

constraint.title: Easy Provider Addition
constraint.description: Adding new providers (Gemini in Story 9.2) requires only: new provider class implementing BaseProvider, single if/elif update in factory, zero changes to existing providers or calling code.

constraint.title: Async Patterns
constraint.description: Use async/await consistently. Async context managers for resource cleanup. Follow existing patterns from backend/api/llm_client.py.

constraint.title: Preserve Exception Hierarchy
constraint.description: Keep LLMClientError, ProviderError, RateLimitError exception types. Structured logging with extra fields. Graceful degradation on provider failures.

tests.standards: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async test support. Mock HTTP requests with respx or httpretty. Test both success and failure paths. Target 80%+ code coverage for provider code. Unit tests must be fast and deterministic (mock external services). Integration tests validate end-to-end flows with real APIs (if keys available). Regression tests ensure all existing tests pass without modification.
